notes.title: Major improvements + changes made in recent weeks
Fix Update!
notes.content:
Hello friends! Many thanks for your support.

An update to fix the game freeze and interface improvements are now available for download.

notes.title: We are at TGS 2020!
notes.content:
[h1]We are at TGS 2020![/h1]

We were chosen for the [b]Tokyo Game Show 2020[/b] Indie Online area! Very proud to be part of this great game party.

Being among the best 80 indies games in the world in the first online TGS in history is a great achievement! It certainly gives us strength and energy to keep creating a great game for you! Launch time is coming! [b]Wishlist now!!! [/b]
